name: Thirty-Two Frames
label: Revelation
lede: Jay Palumbo walked out of Elliott and into a Kentucky quartet that made one EP, engineered by the drummer he'd just left behind.

eras.title: Out of Elliott
eras.text: Jay Palumbo left Elliott after False Cathedrals over creative differences. His new band pulled from the Kentucky hardcore scene: Thommy Browne, drummer for Endpoint and Enkindels, and Mount Washington guitarist Jim Dzurovcak of XinvictusX.

years.p: After False Cathedrals, guitarist Jay Palumbo quits [[Elliott|b3250fd8-d202-4d4a-8fb3-1fdf88176aff]] over creative differences, and starts singing as well as playing in Thirty-Two Frames.

years.h: Thirty-Two Frames record at NonLinear Studios
years.p: Jay Palumbo, Jim Dzurovcak, bassist Jeremy Holehan and Thommy Browne produce themselves. The engineer is [[Kevin Ratterman|44e97d75-ec33-42e8-907d-65fdea0f056d]], Elliott's drummer, with Mike Blaine.

eras.title: One EP, two labels
eras.text: The session came out twice in 2002: a six-song CD on Revelation and a longer vinyl on Rise Records with a Tom Petty cover tacked on the end.

years.p: Six songs, from the 1:53 opener Crow/Sioux War through Chippewa and Affluenza to Thanksgiving, which runs 8:28.

years.h: Rise Records' vinyl adds Tom Petty's I Need To Know
years.p: The 12" on Rise Records (rise 022), on orange and black vinyl, adds ...And If I Said Nothing, Third Party Point of View and a cover of Tom Petty's I Need To Know.

eras.title: Everybody back to their other bands
eras.text: Thirty-Two Frames left one record. Its members went on in the Louisville and Kentucky scenes, and twenty years later Palumbo was back in the band he'd left.

years.h: Palumbo and Dzurovcak regroup in Sunday Evening Dinner Club
years.p: Jay Palumbo and Jim Dzurovcak play together again in Sunday Evening Dinner Club; Palumbo also turns up in [[By the Grace of God|42a5a24f-7fa9-4790-879d-fe5fb3d91f9f]]. Thommy Browne keeps drumming in [[Black Cross|de4316a2-cd05-4bb6-9bc6-0c9290274a93]] and others.

years.h: Jay Palumbo rejoins Elliott for Furnace Fest
years.p: Nineteen years after [[Elliott|b3250fd8-d202-4d4a-8fb3-1fdf88176aff]] broke up, Palumbo is back on guitar for the reunion alongside Chris Higdon and Kevin Ratterman.
